Who we are

Experience across
the battery ecosystem.

Founded in 2002, BPI develops and manufactures lithium-ion, NiMH and NiZn batteries, battery packs and energy storage solutions.

The company operates three subsidiaries focused on lithium batteries, nickel batteries and energy solutions. Its footprint includes a headquarters in Shenzhen, a pilot production base for battery packs and energy storage in Shenzhen, and an industrial park in Jiangxi.
